evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratifying a contract that prioritizes reliable, fast return of a receipt appeals to stability/security (conservation) and mastery of the system's responsiveness (competence).

evidence.quote: no lost work if the client drops the receipt

observations.why: Framing the design around preventing loss appeals to security and preservation of what works — conservation.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Presenting the agent's choice between polling and piggybacking as a design decision appeals to self-directed control over cadence (autonomy) and effective handling of the task (competence).
